The fix I made to `duration.py`:

```python
def parse_duration(text):
    """Return the number of seconds described by `text`."""
    total = 0
    for match in re.finditer(r"(\d+)([hms])", text):
        total += int(match.group(1)) * UNITS[match.group(2)]
    if total == 0 and text:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot parse duration: {text!r}")
    return total
```

This uses `re.finditer` to extract all duration components (hours, minutes, seconds) from the string and sums their contributions in seconds. This handles combined formats like `'1h30m'` (which now correctly returns 5400 seconds) as well as the individual `'45s'` and `'2h'` cases. All 3 tests pass.
